design.purpose: A low landscape phone stand for one user: the phone rests across two double-height pillars while its charging cable passes through the clear space between them.

steps.c: Set the brown plate flat as the base.
Press the dark red brick onto the left end of the plate.
Press the green brick onto the dark red brick.
Press the red brick onto the right end of the plate.
Press the orange brick onto the red brick.
